title: About Me
intro: Software developer focused on building complete full stack applications, combining modern interface design with solid and scalable backend architectures.
card1Text: I focus on deeply understanding the problem before writing code, designing simple, efficient, and modular solutions.
card2Text: I refine my skills by building production-grade applications, diving deep into design patterns and continuous optimization.
card3Text: I prioritize best practices, security, and maintainable code to create dependable and long-lasting software.
p1: I’m especially interested in understanding how an application works beyond the interface: from endpoint design and business rules to code organization and database integration.
p2: I enjoy working on projects where I can apply good practices, write maintainable code, and improve both technically and in solving real problems.
p3: I complement my technical profile by developing advanced full stack projects, implementing secure authentication, relational databases, and AI agents.
sideText1: Building full stack web applications and AI-powered solutions.
sideText2: Backend architecture in ASP.NET Core and Node.js with reactive frontend in React.
